beat: Bobby upset at unequal milk experience; Dhika refuses milk and privately considers crossed limit; unresolved endpoint
translationStatus: complete working local draft / author review pending

lines.original: Dhika hit her head with her hand and looked at Bantu.... Bantu gave a wide teeth smile....
lines.local: Dhika ne apne sir par haath maara aur Bantu ki taraf dekha; Bantu ne daant dikhaakar badi smile di.

lines.original: Dhika: with a little smile... is that all that is running in your mind now ?
lines.local: Dhika halki muskurahat ke saath: Ab tumhare dimaag mein bas yahi chal raha hai?
Bobby ab bhi innocent nazron se: Hmmm...

lines.original: Dhika: ahhhhhh dear,......... its not yours to drink Bobby,...... and Not Yours Tooo, she barked playfully at Bantu....
lines.local: Dhika: Aahh dear, Bobby, woh doodh tumhare peene ke liye nahi hai! Aur tumhare liye bhi nahi! Usne Bantu ko playful andaaz mein daanta.

lines.original: Bantu: but I am lucky enough..... one more drop miss..., please please....
lines.local: Bantu: Lekin main lucky tha! Miss, ek boond aur, please, please!

lines.original: Dhika: aiiii...... I am going to kill you, she threw the pillow at him...
lines.local: Dhika: Aiii, jaan le loongi tumhari! Usne pillow phenka.

lines.original: Bobby:. hmmmm.... he looked like a child who lost his only chocolate to his brother
lines.local: Bobby: Hmmm... Woh aise udaas laga jaise bhai ne uski akeli chocolate cheen li ho.

lines.original: Dhika: awwwhh........Bobby,.... why are you looking so sad like this now!!!!
lines.local: Dhika: Aww Bobby, ab itna udaas kyun ho rahe ho?

lines.original: Dhika: dear ..... its not like I gave a candy to Bantu but not to you.... please... don't be sad.. pleaseeeee
lines.local: Dhika: Dear, aisa toh nahi maine Bantu ko candy de di aur tumhe nahi. Please udaas mat ho, please!

lines.original: Whatever she said did not make Bobby smile.... He wasn't stubborn.... but he wasn't happy either...
lines.local: Dhika kuch bhi kahe, Bobby ke chehre par smile nahi aayi. Woh ziddi nahi tha, bas khush bhi nahi tha.

lines.original: Dhika thought what she will do now.... its not like she can give him a drop of her milk... that would be so much crossing limits.....
lines.local: Dhika sochne lagi ab kya kare. Aisa thodi hai ki woh use apne milk ki boond de sakti hai—yeh bahut badi limit cross karna hoga.

lines.original: Dhika: ..... but just now stupid Bantu took a drop and tasted it.... all these because of him.....
lines.local: Dhika man mein: Lekin abhi stupid Bantu ne toh ek boond le hi li aur taste bhi kar li... sab usi ke kaaran hua.

lines.original: Dhika: hmmmm, no... all these because of me only..... she pouted her lips..
lines.local: Dhika man mein: Hmmm, nahi... yeh sab meri hi wajah se hua. Usne hont phula liye. Episode yahin khatam hota hai.
